title: Part-time Administrative Assistant - Temp Ongoing
description:
Your new company
A well known organisation is looking for an experienced Personal Assistant to provide Administrative support to their CEO, this role manages executive administration, governance support, meeting coordination and document generation.
Work Pattern
Part-time 3 days, 21hrs, per week 7.5 hours per day
Fully on-site in BA3
Your new role

- Managing a busy diary and co-ordinating meetings, events and appointments.
- Preparing meeting documentation.
- Drafting routine correspondence, reports and presentations.
- Processing expenses and maintaining confidential records.
- Handling telephone and email enquiries and acting as a key point of contact.
- Co-ordinating travel arrangements and conference bookings.
- Maintaining compliance records, filing systems and documentation.
- Supporting committee meetings and producing meeting minutes.

- Strong organisational and prioritisation skills.
- Confidence building relationships with senior stakeholders, suppliers and external contacts.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.

title: Administrator - Export Team
salary_text: £13 per hour (Onsite Canteen, onsite convenience store, 26 day)
description:
We're looking for an Export Coordinator / Administrator to join a busy team, supporting the worldwide export of spares and repairs. You'll play an important role in ensuring shipments are processed accurately, on time and in line with customer requirements and export regulations. Based in Yeovil, this is a temporary role and the team currently work hybrid, 3 days in the office and 2 days at home (training will be full time in the office).
What you'll be doing:
- Coordinating worldwide exports of spares and repairs to customers and suppliers.
- Preparing export documentation to meet HM Revenue & Customs and Department for Business & Trade requirements, as well as customer-specific requirements.
- Producing shipping documents that comply with contractual and country-specific regulations.
- Ensuring documentation meets Letter of Credit requirements where applicable.
- Completing export entries using the GTS system where required.
- Monitoring customer orders to ensure goods are despatched on time and in line with agreed service levels.
- Acting as a point of contact for internal departments, responding to queries efficiently.
- Keeping stakeholders updated on shipment progress and delivery arrangements.
- Ensuring export procedures, including export licences and commodity codes, are followed correctly.
- Liaising with packing contractors to ensure goods are prepared for shipment within agreed timescales.
- Booking air, sea and road freight with freight forwarders and customer-appointed agents.
- Checking freight invoices against agreed rates before processing for payment.
- Maintaining accurate export records and departmental documentation.
- Ensuring shipping documentation is issued and distributed in line with company procedures.
- Identifying opportunities to improve processes and ways of working.
- Supporting colleagues within the Export team and providing cover during periods of absence or increased workload.

What we're looking for:
- Previous experience in an Export Coordinator, Shipping Administrator, Logistics Administrator or similar administration role.
- Experience within a shipping or distribution environment would be beneficial.
- Strong administration and organisational skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Good attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks.
- Confident using Microsoft Word, Excel and SAP (SAP is desirable)
- A proactive approach with a focus on delivering excellent customer service.

LOCATION: Wincanton, Somerset

HOURS: 8am - 5pm, Monday - Friday

Known for their technical expertise, high-quality service and collaborative culture, they work on prestigious projects and offer excellent opportunities for professional growth.

- Supporting the engineers with scheduling of work by phone or email.
- Book in contracted work with clients, notifying them of attendance in advance
- Assist with invoicing and collating supporting documentation
- Preparation of Health & Safety paperwork for contracts repair work
- Support with general administration

- Previous experience in an administrative, coordination or customer service role.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage a varied workload.

- Comfortable using Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Experience within maintenance, facilities management, construction, engineering or a similar industry would be beneficial, but is not essential.

title: Warranty Administrator
description:
Job Title: Warranty Administrator Fixed Term Contract

Location: Ilminster, Somerset

Salary: Dependant on experience (to be discussed at application)

Job Type: Full-time, Fixed Term Contract

Hours: 9-5 (Mon-Thurs), 9-4.30 (Fri)

What's on Offer:
- Opportunity to join a stable and growing business
- Supportive team environment with a strong focus on collaboration
- Varied role with scope to develop your skills
- Competitive salary and benefits package including 25 days plus BH and free parking

We are currently supporting a well-established and growing manufacturer to recruit a Customer Service Administrator. This is an exciting opportunity to join a customer focused organisation where service quality and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything they do.

The Role

As Customer Service Administrator, you will play a key role in delivering a high-quality warranty service, ensuring customers receive a seamless and efficient experience. Acting as a central point of contact, you will manage warranty claims, coordinate service activity, and support internal teams in maintaining strong customer relationships.

This is a varied and fast-paced role, ideal for someone who thrives in a busy environment and enjoys problem-solving, organisation, and customer interaction.

Key Responsibilities
- Respond to warranty claims via phone and email in a timely and professional manner
- Log all communications and maintain accurate records using the CRM system
- Coordinate the dispatch of replacement parts and raise associated orders
- Arrange collections of faulty components in line with company procedures
- Authorise and organise service callouts in accordance with warranty terms
- Process invoices and manage documentation related to service visits
- Analyse service reports to identify recurring issues and opportunities for improvement
- Build and maintain effective relationships with external service partners

About You

We're looking for an organised and proactive individual with excellent communication skills and a strong customer service mindset.
- Experience working in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment
- Proven ability to manage a varied workload and prioritise tasks effectively
- Strong administrative and organisational skills
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office
- Solid communication skills, both written and verbal

LOCATION: Ilminster
